name: es-memory-bridge
description: Self-contained ES Archive server. Hosts the engine in-process: Core Data archive, multilingual semantic vector search (EmbeddingGemma, 100+ languages), line-level grep, and a Unix-pipeline-style search surface (archive_cli), speaking MCP over stdio. Provides Claude with persistent memory: store, retrieve, organize, curate, and chain entries across sessions. No companion app required; all data stays on your machine or syncs via your private iCloud.
